body: You own Q13: RingSpace.gd plus its test, both yours because you have a shell. Operator ruled 2026-09-09 that the fight becomes real time with real movement, overturning U18's no-XY refusal. Q13 is safe to build BEFORE the research lands because under every candidate design two men have positions on a bounded floor - pure arithmetic, zero preloads, no simulation coupling. The one thing that matters most: place_of returns G27's exact three words CENTRE/ROPES/CORNER so RingPlace's ladder becomes a derived view of a real position instead of a parallel truth, and you may NOT preload RingPlace - the strings are duplicated by contract, deliberately. Traps: a boundary is inclusive, pressure of a degenerate floor is 0.0 because it is unmeasured, and ON_CYCLE is not in this module. Suite reads total=192 fails=0 right now; yours should make it 193. research/TASK_Q13.md is self-contained.
